item.title: What Is Our Relationship with Pollinators?
item.description: Explore our relationship with pollinators like bees and butterflies through Indigenous knowledge, hands-on learning, and everyday stewardship.

item.title: Laser Dome Turns 50
item.description: Celebrate 50 years of the iconic Laser Dome at Pacific Science Center with immersive shows, exclusive merch, and a month-long birthday bash.

item.title: From Summer Camp to Future Careers
item.description: Pacific Science Center’s summer camps inspired 3,800+ kids through STEM exploration, hands-on learning, and guest experts.

item.title: Why Do Pinecones Open and Close and How Does That Affect Seeds?
item.description: Discover why pinecones open and close, how they protect and release seeds, and what makes Washington’s pine trees unique this fall.

item.title: Saying Farewell to Our Tide Pool Exhibit
item.description: Celebrate the legacy of our beloved tide pool exhibit, discover its residents’ new home, and get ready for PacSci’s refreshed spaces this fall.

item.description: Discover how Mariners fans and the Pacific Northwest Seismic Network (PNSN) turned a record-breaking playoff game into a seismic moment.

item.description: Learn how Camps for Curious Minds inspire kids across Seattle and King County with fun, educational STEM experiences all summer long.

item.title: Hands-On Science Inspires Washington Students
item.description: Learn how PacSci brought hands-on STEM learning to thousands of WA students in the 2024–25 school year.

item.title: Remembering PacSci’s Beloved Dinosaurs
item.description: Discover how Pacific Science Center’s dinosaurs delighted generations of visitors and became a cherished part of its history.

item.title: PacSci’s Beloved Dinosaurs Are Looking for New Homes
item.description: Adopt a piece of PacSci history! Support STEM education by claiming one of PacSci’s beloved dinosaurs in this special fundraising campaign.
